canonical_statement: In an o-minimal expansion of a dense linear order without endpoints, every unary function whose domain and restricted graph are definable admits a finite pairwise-disjoint partition of its domain into singleton or order-convex pieces on which it is continuous and constant, strictly increasing, or strictly decreasing.
domain_and_universes: universes u v w; first-order language L : Language.{u,v}; carrier M : Type w; an ordered L-structure on a dense linear order without endpoints carrying its order topology; Prop in universe 0
ordered_binders: ordered-language, L-structure, linear-order, compatibility, density, no-endpoint, and order-topology instances
definable domain A and unary function f
definability of A and of the graph of f restricted to A
hypotheses: the distinguished language relation is interpreted as the carrier order
the carrier is a dense linear order without endpoints with its order topology
every parameter-definable unary set is a finite union of order-convex sets
the graph of f restricted to A is parameter-definable
conclusion: There is a finite pairwise-disjoint cover of A by subsets of A; every piece is order-convex and is either a singleton or supports continuity together with constant, strictly increasing, or strictly decreasing behavior of f.

encoding_decisions.parameter_convention: Set.univ.Definable and Set.univ.Definable1 permit parameters from the whole carrier
encoding_decisions.o_minimality: finite union of order-convex unary definable subsets; empty and singleton components are permitted
encoding_decisions.function: total Lean function with a separately frozen definable domain and definable restricted graph
encoding_decisions.partition: Finset of pairwise-disjoint subsets whose sUnion is exactly A
encoding_decisions.pieces: singleton pieces need no continuity condition; all other pieces are order-convex, continuous, and constant or strictly monotone
encoding_decisions.endpoints: the ambient dense order has neither a minimum nor a maximum; A and its pieces may be bounded, unbounded, open, closed, half-open, empty, or singleton

killed: changed the definable domain to the whole carrier
moved the finite partition existential outside the domain binder
removed continuity and monotonicity from the conclusion
